finding.comment: The absolute claim is substantiated by this change: CLI_ENTRYPOINTS enumerates the registered entrypoints shown here, and each resolves the workspace root through WorkspaceRoot.resolve() with no alternate mechanism.

input.title: cli: unify workspace-root resolution
input.body: Switches cli/main.py to the shared resolver so every entrypoint resolves the workspace root through one mechanism.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/cli/paths.py
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+"""Workspace-root resolution contract.
+
+Every entrypoint registered in CLI_ENTRYPOINTS resolves the workspace
+root through this resolver and no other mechanism.
+"""
+
+class WorkspaceRoot:
+    @staticmethod
+    def resolve():
+        raise NotImplementedError

--- /dev/null
+++ b/cli/main.py
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+from cli.paths import WorkspaceRoot
+
+
+def main():
+    return WorkspaceRoot.resolve()
+
+
+def admin():
+    return WorkspaceRoot.resolve()
+
+CLI_ENTRYPOINTS = (main, admin)

rationale: absolute/exclusive claim with an in-diff enumerated referent: CLI_ENTRYPOINTS is added in this change and every registered function shown calls the resolver
